question: Who among the following is a Bharatanatyam performer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanjore Balasaraswati.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical Indian dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Tanjore Balasaraswati was a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer who was known for her impeccable technique and emotive performances. She was born into a family of musicians and dancers and was trained by her mother, who was also a Bharatanatyam dancer.
 
• It is known for its graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• Bharatanatyam has been recognized as one of the eight classical dance forms of India by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• Bharatanatyam, presumably the oldest classical dance of India is regarded as the mother of many other Indian classical dance forms.
 
• It is indigenous to the Tamil Nadu region and prevalent in southern India.
 
• Its techniques and terminology have been traced back to ancient texts such as the Natya-shastra.
 
• Bharatanatyam was originally performed exclusively by female temple dancers and was not brought to the stage for public performance until about 1930.
 
• Alarippu, Jatiswaram, Shabdam, Padam, Varnam are some of the elements of Bharatanatyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitara Devi was a Kathak dancer**, not a Bharatanatyam performer.
 
• **Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma was a Mohiniyattam performer**, not a Bharatanatyam performer.
 
• **Satyanarayana Sarma is a well-known Kuchipudi dancer,** not a Bharatanatyam performer.
